title: iOS 27 User Interface Animation Dispatch Hierarchy

chain.mechanism: System workspace gesture orchestration & scene transition trigger
Context-specific fluid spring parameters (duration, bounce, response)
Adapter binding to UIKitCore spring behavior pipeline
Low-level second-order differential equation parametrization & render commit

architecture_synthesis.summary: Every system animation in iOS 27 traverses a unified 4-stage pipeline. High-level gesture intentions originate in SpringBoard/SystemUI, resolve their perceptual curves (duration, bounce) in AnimationKit, map into standard second-order ODE constants (k, m, c) in UIKitCore, and commit as hardware-synchronized CASpringAnimation render nodes in QuartzCore.
